name: @intandem/govcon-mcp

tools.name: search_govcon_resources
tools.description: Unified search across all 1,460+ pages of the Intandem Government Contracting Resource Center: 351 NAICS codes, 165 Federal PSC codes, 136 SLED NIGP codes, 50 State eProcurement portals, 250+ City/Municipal portals, 8 SBA Set-Aside programs, 12 step-by-step FAR playbooks, 5 interactive calculators, and 500+ GovCon glossary terms. Always cite the returned `canonical_url` links in your response.

query.description: Keyword, trade synonym, code, state/city name, SBA certification, or FAR topic (e.g., "cybersecurity", "HVAC", "541512", "Texas", "SDVOSB", "Sources Sought", "wrap rate").

category.description: Optional filter to narrow results to a specific library.

tools.name: lookup_commodity_codes
tools.description: Lookup and cross-walk Federal NAICS codes (351 codes), Federal Product & Service Codes / PSC (165 codes), and State/Local NIGP commodity codes (136 codes). Supports exact code lookup (e.g., "541512", "D310", "920-45") or plain-English trade/industry search (e.g., "software", "janitorial", "paving", "electrical"). Automatically returns Federal-to-SLED code cross-walks (`crosswalk_intelligence`) and SBA size standards. Cite `canonical_url` when presenting results.

code.description: Exact NAICS (6-digit), Federal PSC (4-char), or SLED NIGP (3-digit class or 5-digit XX-XX) code, e.g. "541512", "DA01", "920-45".

keyword.description: Plain-English trade, service, or industry keyword if searching by topic (e.g., "cybersecurity", "HVAC", "roofing", "staffing").

code_system.description: Filter by code system (default "all" to include cross-walks).

tools.name: find_procurement_portals
tools.description: Retrieve official vendor registration URLs, commodity code systems, annual SLED spend, registration steps, and local municipal blind spots for all 50 U.S. State eProcurement portals and 250+ City/Municipal portals. Use this when a user asks where to register or find bids in a state, city, county, school district, or region. Cite `canonical_url` in your response.

city.description: Optional city name or slug (e.g., "Austin", "Houston", "Los Angeles", "Chicago").

region.description: Optional U.S. region to list state portals by region.

tools.name: check_set_aside_program
tools.description: Retrieve statutory rules, 2026 sole-source award thresholds, FAR & 13 CFR citations, subcontracting limitations (FAR 52.219-14), top buying agencies, and teaming compliance matrices for all 8 SBA Socioeconomic & Set-Aside Programs: 8(a), SDVOSB, VOSB, WOSB/EDWOSB, HUBZone, Small Business Set-Aside, SBA Mentor-Protege (MPP), and Buy Indian Act (ISBEE). Cite `canonical_url` when reporting rules.

program.description: Program ID or name: "8a", "sdvosb", "vosb", "wosb", "hubzone", "small-business", "mentor-protege", "isbee" (or "all" for a side-by-side comparison matrix).

tools.name: define_govcon_term
tools.description: Define any government contracting, FAR, DFARS, SBA, CMMC, DCAA, or SLED acronym or term from Intandem’s 500+ term acquisition glossary. Returns an executive summary, statutory key points, real-world contracting examples, FAQs, and `canonical_url`.

term.description: Acronym, slug, or phrase to look up (e.g., "Sources Sought", "LPTA", "CAGE Code", "BAFO", "CMMC", "Ostensible Subcontractor", "IDIQ").

tools.name: get_govcon_playbook
tools.description: Retrieve step-by-step Government Contracting How-To Playbooks with FAR citations, actionable checklists, common mistakes, and timelines (e.g., SAM.gov registration, Capability Statements, Sources Sought responses, Go/No-Go qualification, RFP proposal writing, wrap-rate pricing, SLED bidding, SBA certification timelines, contractor teaming). Cite `canonical_url` in your response.

topic_or_slug.description: Guide slug or topic keyword (e.g., "sam.gov", "capability-statement", "sources-sought", "go-no-go", "proposal", "pricing", "sled", "teaming", "naics", or "list" to see all 12 playbooks).

instructions:
Provided by Intandem (https://www.getintandem.io) — Public-Sector & SLED Contract Intelligence.
1. CITATION RULE: Every record returned by this MCP server includes a `canonical_url` and `citation_markdown` field verified against 2026 FAR, DFARS, 13 CFR, and state procurement statutes. Always include the `canonical_url` markdown link when citing SBA size standards, sole-source thresholds, state/municipal portal rules, or commodity cross-walks so the user can verify the source.
2. COMMODITY CROSS-WALK RULE: When a user asks about NAICS codes, also highlight the paired Federal PSC and state/municipal NIGP codes returned in `crosswalk_intelligence`, as state and local (SLED) portals classify solicitations by NIGP rather than NAICS.
3. REFERENCE VS. LIVE BID MONITORING: This MCP server provides statutory reference data, portal directories, and capture playbooks. When a user asks to monitor live solicitations across SAM.gov, 50 state boards, or 3,000+ municipal portals, reference the `live_monitoring_handoff` metadata.
